# Ankit Traders Billing — deployment guide

Two ways to run this app. Both are 100% self-contained, so no sandbox link is needed.

## 1. Single-file app (recommended for permanent hosting)

File: **`public/standalone/ankit-traders-billing.html`**

* All HTML + CSS + JS is in one file (logo and your doctors/medicines/invoice/collection entries are embedded).
* No server, no database, no build step. Data is stored in the browser (`localStorage`).
* Print + PDF + JPG: **A5 (148 × 210 mm)**, print margins **10 mm**, export `html2canvas scale: 3` (≈300 DPI).

### GitHub Pages
1. Create a repository, upload `ankit-traders-billing.html` as `index.html`.
2. Settings → Pages → Branch `main` → `/ (root)` → Save.
3. Open `https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/`.

### Netlify
1. Drag the folder containing the file (renamed to `index.html`) onto <https://app.netlify.com/drop>.
2. Done — the generated URL is permanent.

### Vercel
1. `vercel deploy` a folder containing `index.html` (or import the repo in the dashboard).
2. Framework preset: **Other**, output directory: the folder with `index.html`.

### Local / pendrive
Open the file directly in Chrome, or use Android Chrome → **⋮ → Add to Home screen** after hosting it.

> **Backups:** the sidebar has **Backup JSON** (export all entries) and **Restore JSON** (import on another device).
> **Downloading the file:** the app sidebar has a **Download single-file app** button; inside the file use **Save app file**.

## 2. Next.js + PostgreSQL version (this repository)

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm start          # http://localhost:3000
```

* `DATABASE_URL` is read from `.env`; `npx drizzle-kit push` creates the tables.
* On first start the existing Ankit Traders records are restored automatically if the database is empty.
* Deploy to Vercel/Netlify by connecting the repository and setting `DATABASE_URL` (Neon/Supabase/Railway).

Rebuild the single-file app after any change:

```bash
node scripts/build-standalone.mjs
```

# Push this project to GitHub (then Vercel)

You only need to do this **once**. Two ways — pick whichever is easier.

---

## Option A — Upload with the GitHub website (no terminal, works on mobile)

1. Download **`ankit-traders-project.zip`** (needs to unzip) **or** open
   **`ankit-traders-source-bundle.html`** (no unzip; copy each file).
2. On GitHub: **New repository** → name `ankit-traders-billing` → Private or Public →
   **Create repository**.
3. In the new repo click **Add file → Upload files**.
4. Drag the **contents** of the unzipped `ankit-traders-billing/` folder
   (`src`, `public`, `standalone`, `scripts`, `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`,
   `next.config.ts`, `postcss.config.mjs`, `eslint.config.mjs`, `drizzle.config.json`,
   `vercel.json`, `README.md`, `.env.example`, …).
   * Do **not** upload `node_modules`, `.next` or `.env`.
   * `.gitignore` is already correct, so those stay out.
5. Commit: message `Ankit Traders billing app with A5 print + HD exports` → **Commit changes**.
6. Continue with **Deploy on Vercel** below.

> If drag-and-drop of folders fails on mobile, use **Option B** or the source bundle:
> create each file with *Add file → Create new file*, type the path (e.g. `src/app/page.tsx`)
> and paste the content from the bundle.

---

## Option B — Push from your computer (one command)

Requirements: [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads) and Node.js 20+.

```bash
# 1) create an empty repo on GitHub first (no README, no .gitignore)

# 2) unzip the project and enter it
unzip ankit-traders-project.zip
cd ankit-traders-billing

# 3) run the helper (macOS/Linux/Git-Bash)
bash push-to-github.sh https://github.com/<your-user>/ankit-traders-billing.git
```

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
.\push-to-github.ps1 -RepoUrl https://github.com/<your-user>/ankit-traders-billing.git
```

The script runs `git init`, adds everything except `node_modules` / `.next` / `.env`,
commits and pushes to `main`.

Manually, if you prefer:

```bash
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Ankit Traders billing app with A5 print + HD exports"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/<your-user>/ankit-traders-billing.git
git push -u origin main
```

If GitHub asks for a password, create a **Personal Access Token**
(<https://github.com/settings/tokens> → *Generate new token (classic)* → scope `repo`)
and paste it as the password.

---

## Deploy on Vercel (permanent link)

1. Create a free PostgreSQL database — **Neon**, **Supabase**, **Railway** or
   **Vercel Postgres** — and copy the connection string
   (`postgresql://user:pass@host/db?sslmode=require`).
2. <https://vercel.com/new> → **Import Git Repository** → select your repo.
3. Framework preset: **Next.js** (auto-detected). Leave build/output defaults.
4. **Environment Variables** → `DATABASE_URL` = your connection string
   (tick Production, Preview and Development) → **Deploy**.
5. One-time table creation, from your computer:

   ```bash
   npm install
   echo 'DATABASE_URL="postgresql://…"' > .env
   npx drizzle-kit push
   ```

6. Open your new `https://<project>.vercel.app` link — the app restores your existing
   records (25 doctors, 42 medicines, invoice, collection) when the tables are empty.

### After every future change
`git add . && git commit -m "update" && git push` → Vercel redeploys automatically.

---

## Don’t want a server at all?

Use the **single-file offline app**: `ankit-traders-billing.html`.
Rename it to `index.html`, upload it to a GitHub repo, enable **Settings → Pages**
(branch `main`, folder `/root`) and you get a permanent
`https://<your-user>.github.io/<repo>/` link — no database, no build, data stored
in the browser with JSON backup/restore.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Push this project to an existing empty GitHub repository.
# Usage: bash push-to-github.sh https://github.com/<user>/<repo>.git
set -euo pipefail

REPO_URL="${1:-}"
if [ -z "$REPO_URL" ]; then
  echo "Usage: bash push-to-github.sh https://github.com/<user>/<repo>.git"
  echo "Create the empty repository on GitHub first (no README, no .gitignore)."
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "Run this script from inside the unzipped ankit-traders-billing folder."
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d .git ]; then
  git init
fi

# keep secrets & build output out of the repository
cat > .gitignore <<'GITIGNORE'
node_modules/
.next/
out/
build/
.env
.env*.local
.DS_Store
*.log
.vercel
public/ankit-traders-project.zip
GITIGNORE

git add .
git commit -m "Ankit Traders billing app with A5 print + HD PDF/JPG exports" || echo "(nothing new to commit)"
git branch -M main

if git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git remote set-url origin "$REPO_URL"
else
  git remote add origin "$REPO_URL"
fi

git push -u origin main

echo
echo "Pushed to $REPO_URL"
echo "Next: import the repo at https://vercel.com/new, add DATABASE_URL, deploy,"
echo "then run: npx drizzle-kit push"

# Ankit Traders Billing — Herbal Products Invoice & Market Collection

Fullstack billing app for **Ankit Traders** (Barkagoan Mansingh Patti, Buxar):
doctor-wise herbal billing, saved invoice archive, daily market-collection ledger and
48-month reports — with **A5 print**, **A5 PDF** and **A5 JPG (high resolution)** exports.

Tech: **Next.js 16 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM**.

---

## ✨ Latest fixes (included in this code)

| # | Fix | Where |
|---|-----|-------|
| 1 | **Print = A5, 10 mm margin** — `@page { size: A5 portrait; margin: 10mm }`, print sheet outside the app shell so the output is never blank, exact colour printing | `src/app/a5-print.css`, `src/lib/export-a5.ts` |
| 2 | **PDF + JPG = exact A5 (148 × 210 mm) at high quality** — `html2canvas scale: 3` (≈300 DPI), JPEG quality 0.96, fonts/images pre-loaded, long sheets continue on extra A5 pages | `src/lib/export-a5.ts` |
| 3 | Everything else unchanged — same design, 5 tabs, 30–60 % discounts, qty 1–300, back dues, 48-month archives, reports | `src/components/*` |

Both the invoice memo **and** the market-collection statement use the same A5 engine.

---

## 🚀 Deploy on Vercel (permanent link)

### 1. Push the code to GitHub

```bash
unzip ankit-traders-project.zip -d ankit-traders-billing
cd ankit-traders-billing
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Ankit Traders billing app with A5 print + HD exports"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/<your-user>/ankit-traders-billing.git
git push -u origin main
```

(No terminal? On GitHub: **New repository → Add file → Upload files** → drag the unzipped
project folder contents → Commit. Skip `node_modules`, `.next`, `.env`.)

### 2. Create a free PostgreSQL database

Any of these works: **Neon**, **Supabase**, **Railway**, **Vercel Postgres**.
Copy the connection string, e.g.

```
postgresql://user:password@host/dbname?sslmode=require
```

### 3. Import the repo in Vercel

1. <https://vercel.com/new> → **Import Git Repository** → pick your repo.
2. Framework preset: **Next.js** (auto-detected). Build `npm run build`, output default.
3. **Environment Variables** → add `DATABASE_URL` = your Postgres URL (Production + Preview).
4. **Deploy**. You get a permanent link like `https://ankit-traders-billing.vercel.app`.

### 4. Create the tables (one time)

Run locally against the production database:

```bash
echo 'DATABASE_URL="postgresql://…"' > .env
npm install
npx drizzle-kit push
```

On the first request the app restores the existing Ankit Traders records
(25 doctors, 42 medicines, saved invoice, market collection) when the tables are empty —
see `src/db/seed.ts` + `src/db/seed-data.json`.

### Other hosts

* **Netlify** — "Import from Git", build `npm run build`, add the `next` plugin (or use
  `@netlify/plugin-nextjs`) and the same `DATABASE_URL` variable.
* **Any VPS** — `npm ci && npm run build && npm start` behind Nginx.
* **No server at all?** Use the **single-file app**: `public/ankit-traders-billing.html`
  (self-contained offline copy for GitHub Pages / Netlify Drop).

---

## 🧑‍💻 Local development

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env          # then edit DATABASE_URL
npx drizzle-kit push          # create tables
npm run dev                   # http://localhost:3000
```

Useful scripts:

```bash
npm run build                 # production build
npm start                     # production server
npm run typecheck             # tsc --noEmit
node scripts/build-standalone.mjs   # rebuild the single-file offline HTML app
node scripts/build-project-zip.mjs  # rebuild the downloadable source ZIP
```

---

## 🗂️ Project structure

```
src/
  app/
    page.tsx                  # workspace (server component, loads initial data)
    layout.tsx                # fonts + metadata + manifest
    globals.css               # Tailwind + theme imports
    app-theme.css             # full visual design system
    a5-print.css              # A5 paper, print rules, export stage  ← A5 fix
    download/page.tsx         # /download page (ZIP + single file links)
    api/
      health/                 # GET /api/health
      masters/                # GET doctors + medicines
      doctors/[id]/           # POST, PATCH, DELETE
      medicines/[id]/         # POST, PATCH, DELETE
      invoices/               # GET list, POST save invoice
      invoices/[id]/          # GET / DELETE invoice
      collections/            # GET ledger, POST entry, DELETE entry
      collections/day-summary/# POST save full day, DELETE unlock
      reports/                # GET month/day billing reports
      download/               # GET single-file HTML (attachment)
      download/project/       # GET full source ZIP (attachment)
  components/
    BillingWorkspace.tsx      # client shell: tabs, state, exports, modals
    CreateInvoiceView.tsx     # Create Invoice tab
    MarketCollectionView.tsx  # Market Collection tab
    MastersView.tsx           # Doctors & Medicines tab
    HistoryView.tsx           # Invoice History tab
    ReportsView.tsx           # Billing Reports tab
    papers.tsx                # A5 invoice & collection statement templates
    ui.tsx, icons.tsx         # shared UI primitives
  db/
    index.ts                  # Drizzle client (DATABASE_URL)
    schema.ts                 # doctos, medicines, invoices, items, collections, day saves
    seed.ts / seed-data.json  # restores existing entries when DB is empty
  lib/
    export-a5.ts              # print + A5 PDF/JPG engine (printA5Sheet, exportA5Pdf/Jpg)
    format.ts, types.ts       # helpers & shared types
    server/data.ts            # queries, 48-month aggregation, invoice numbering
standalone/
  index.template.html         # single-file app shell
  app.js                      # single-file app logic (offline, localStorage)
scripts/
  build-standalone.mjs        # builds public/ankit-traders-billing.html
  build-project-zip.mjs       # builds public/ankit-traders-project.zip
```

---

## 📄 A5 export notes

* **Print** — click *Print Cash Memo (A5)*. The dialog pre-selects A5 paper and 10 mm
  margins (`@page`). A hidden `.print-only-sheet` outside `.app-shell` holds the sheet,
  so nothing is clipped and colours stay exact (`print-color-adjust: exact`).
* **PDF / JPG** — rendered off-screen at `148mm` width, captured with
  `html2canvas scale: 3`, flattened onto a white canvas (no transparency, no fades) and
  exported as A5. Long statements add extra A5 pages automatically.
* Files are named `Ankit-Traders-<InvoiceNo>-A5.pdf` / `.jpg` and
  `Ankit-Traders-Collection-<date|month>-A5.*`.

---

## 🔐 Environment variables

| Key | Required | Example |
|-----|----------|---------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | yes (server version) | `postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db?sslmode=require` |

The app shows a clear runtime error (never a silent 500) if the database is unreachable;
`/api/health` returns `{ ok: true }` only when the database answers.
